answer: A ring of fake identities can be made unstable from the inside. Each account's locked rewards stay claimable by anyone who proves two accounts share a controller, for instance by producing signatures from both keys over the same anchor message. Whoever runs a farm then has to trust every script, server and helper holding those keys, since one leak lets a defector take the whole pool. The risk compounds like a spiral: more fakes mean more keys in more places, and any loose thread pays out.
